'''''Exormotheca''''' is a group of [[Marchantiophyta|liverwort]]s in the family [[Exormothecaceae]].<ref name="itis">{{ITIS |id= 15599|taxon=Exormotheca |accessdate=28 March 2014}}</ref> It was described as a genus in 1870.<ref>Godman, Frederick Ducane. 1870.  Natural History of the Azores, or Western Islands 325</ref><ref>[http://www.tropicos.org/Name/35002023 Tropicos, ''Exormotheca'' Mitt.]</ref><ref>Kürschner, H. 2000. Bryophyte flora of the Arabian Peninsula and Socotra. Bryophytorum Bibliotheca 55: 1–131.</ref>

;Species<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.catalogueoflife.org/annual-checklist/2013/search/all/key/Exormotheca/match/1| title=''Exormotheca''| editor=Roskov Y.| editor2= Kunze T.| editor3=Paglinawan L.| editor4=Orrell T.| editor5=Nicolson D.| editor6=Culham A.| editor7=Bailly N.| editor8=Kirk P.| editor9=Bourgoin T.| editor10=Baillargeon G.| editor11=Hernandez F.| editor12=De Wever A.| year=2013| work =Species 2000 & ITIS Catalogue of Life, 2013 Annual Checklist| publisher=Species 2000| location=Reading, UK| accessdate=28 March 2014}}</ref><ref>[http://www.theplantlist.org/tpl1.1/search?q=Exormotheca The Plant List, search for  ''Exormotheca'']</ref><ref>[http://www.discoverlife.org/mp/20q?search=Exormotheca Discover Life, ''Exormotheca'']</ref><ref name="CV">{{cite journal |last1=Martins |first1=A. |last2=Garcia |first2=C.A. |last3=Patiño |first3=J. |last4=Sim-Sim |first4=M.|title= ''Exormotheca martins-loussaoae'' (Exormothecaceae, Hepaticae), a new species from Cape Verde|journal=Plant Biosystems|date=2023 |volume=157 |issue=2 |pages=294–300 |doi=10.1080/11263504.2022.2100504|bibcode=2023PBios.157..294M |hdl=10451/53991 |hdl-access=free }}</ref>
